content: जानपदः [जानेन उत्पत्त्या पच्चते पद् अप्; जनपदे भवः, अण् वा] .²1 An inhabitant of the country, a rustic, boor, peasant (<ab>opp.</ab> पौर); ततः कतिपयाहःसु वृद्धो जानपदो युवा <ls>Rām. 7. 73. 2</ls>. .²2 A country. .²3 A tax <ab>&c.</ab> from peasants. .²4 subject. .{@-दा@} A popular expression. .{@-दी@} Profession, business.
